title: Aries Weekly Cosmic Firestorm

script_text: Get ready, Aries, for a week as Mars fuels your fire. Monday sees Mars in the 10th house trine Saturn in the 4th, boosting career. Tuesday Mercury square Venus in 7th, stirring love tension and miscommunication. Wednesday’s Sun sextile Jupiter in the 5th house lifts creativity and romance, best day. Thursday, Uranus stations direct in your 1st house, igniting confidence and bold self‑expression. Thursday’s Uranus surge with Venus‑Pluto conjunction in the 7th deepens love intensity and transformative bonds. Friday’s Mars square Neptune in 2nd clouds finances, warning spending. Saturday’s Moon trine Mercury in 10th restores clarity, favoring career moves and networking. Wednesday shines as Sun sextile Jupiter activates 5th house, fueling romance and success. Tuesday strains as Mercury square Venus ignites love missteps, marking the worst day. Channel Mars's fire into a project each day to avoid burnout and keep progress steady. Follow for updates.
